fusions.name: Pasture Nip
fusions.desc: A quick nibble that deals 4 damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Herd Panic
fusions.desc: Darts between the legs of the herd, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%), and every ally deals 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Lost Among Flanks
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and restores 12 health. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Mouthful at a Time
fusions.desc: Every time you hit an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once and heal you for 4% of your maximum health per stack (32% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
